text:
What it is
Sediment grain-size, organic-matter, and stratigraphic data from vibracores, interpreted together with high-resolution seismic records to reconstruct the pre-transgression landscape and Holocene/Pleistocene boundary on the Virginia Coast Reserve (Hog Island Bay area).

Offers a coastal geologic/geophysical dataset focused on sedimentary stratigraphy and sea-level rise history. Students can explore barrier-island evolution, sediment characteristics, or the application of seismic and core data to reconstruct past landscapes.

title: EAES 380 Final Project Dataset Options
text:
How to choose a dataset
Use the dataset pages to compare options side by side. Each page tells you what the dataset is, where it comes from, what it contains, and which analyses it suits.

Start with your interest. Pick the subject area closest to what you want to learn about, then read its three options.
Check the coverage. Every page lists the time span and location. Look for a record long enough, or frequent enough, for your question (for example, 10-minute data supports diurnal cycles, while multi-decade records support trend analysis).
Read the suggested analyses. Each page lists analyses the dataset supports. Ask whether one of them could become your project question.
Check how easy it is to access. Open the EDI metadata page linked on each dataset page. If you hit an authentication prompt, see the access note above. MacroSheds also has an R package and a dashboard linked on its page.
Ask for help if needed. The EDI package ID is listed on every page so you can point to the exact dataset.

title: Earth and Planetary Geophysics
text:
EDI is primarily an ecological/environmental repository, so pure planetary geophysics datasets are limited. The options below emphasize geophysical measurements (thermal profiles, stratigraphy, seismic context) within Earth-system contexts.

1. Bonanza Creek Boreholes
Bonanza Creek LTER: Borehole Temperature Data from Permafrost Site near Fairbanks, Alaska (2009–2021)
Temperature profiles from deep boreholes (40–75 m) in permafrost near Fairbanks, Alaska.
EDI package: knb-lter-bnz.792.2


2. AK Wildfire & Permafrost
Interior Alaska: Climate and Wildfire Effects on Permafrost Soil Temperature Regimes (Hourly Data, 2013–2018)
Hourly soil temperature measurements at depths from 5 to 150 cm at paired burned and unburned sites in Interior Alaska.
EDI package: knb-lter-bnz.717.2


3. VCR Seismic Stratigraphy
Trend Surface Analysis and Seismic Stratigraphy of the Virginia Coast Reserve
Sediment grain-size, organic-matter, and stratigraphic data from vibracores, interpreted together with high-resolution seismic records to reconstruct the pre-transgression landscape and Holocene/Pleistocene boundary on the Virginia Coast Reserve (Hog Island Bay area).
EDI package: knb-lter-vcr.15.19
